meta.prompt: I have four expenses from one report waiting for my approval: Delta Air Lines, Travel, Nov 3, $412.60; Blue Bottle Coffee, Meals, Nov 4, $18.40; Uber, Transport, Nov 5, $36.25 (no receipt attached); WeWork day pass, Office, Nov 6, $45.00. Show them in a card with merchant, category, date and amount, flag the one missing a receipt, and let me approve or reject each (changing my mind is fine). Show how many are approved ("N of 4 approved") and the approved total, and a Submit button; after I submit, the card says Submitted with the count and the total.
meta.text:
state expenses=[{"id":1,"merchant":"Delta Air Lines","category":"Travel","date":"Nov 3","amount":412.60,"receipt":true,"status":"pending"},{"id":2,"merchant":"Blue Bottle Coffee","category":"Meals","date":"Nov 4","amount":18.40,"receipt":true,"status":"pending"},{"id":3,"merchant":"Uber","category":"Transport","date":"Nov 5","amount":36.25,"receipt":false,"status":"pending"},{"id":4,"merchant":"WeWork day pass","category":"Office","date":"Nov 6","amount":45.00,"receipt":true,"status":"pending"}]
state submitted=false
let approved = filter(expenses, e => e.status == "approved")
let approvedCount = length(approved)
let approvedTotal = sum(approved, e => e.amount)
let decided = length(filter(expenses, e => e.status != "pending"))
ChatCard "Expense report" "Four expenses awaiting approval" icon:"receipt_long" status:"Pending" w:390
  if submitted
    Receipt "Submitted" "{approvedCount} expenses approved for ${fixed(approvedTotal,2)}" tone:good icon:"check_circle"
  if !submitted
    each e in expenses
      Row between gap:8
        Column gap:2
          Text.strong "{e.merchant}"
          Text.muted "{e.category} · {e.date}"
          if !e.receipt
            Text.danger "No receipt attached"
        Column gap:2 right
          Text.strong "{money(e.amount,"$",2)}"
          Row gap:6
            Button.outline "Approve" enabled:{e.status != "approved"} -> expenses=updateWhere(expenses, x => x.id == e.id, x => with(x, "status", "approved"))
            Button.ghost "Reject" enabled:{e.status != "rejected"} -> expenses=updateWhere(expenses, x => x.id == e.id, x => with(x, "status", "rejected"))
    Divider
    Row between
      Text.body "{approvedCount} of 4 approved"
      Text.strong "${fixed(approvedTotal,2)}"
    ActionButton "Submit" tone:primary enabled:{decided == 4} -> submitted=true; emit submitExpenses approvedCount
